verdict.en: A cheap, forgiving burst rifle that is fine against raiders, mediocre against ARC, and not worth chasing as an endgame gun.
verdict.zh: 便宜好上手的三连发步枪，打玩家够用，打 ARC 一般，别当终局武器。

use.en: It is the only burst-fire rifle, so it rewards short, aimed bursts at mid to long range and punishes spraying. Community tier lists put it around B in PvP and C in PvE: armor penetration is only moderate, so aim at the weak spots on the back of ARC. Players commonly run a Compensator, Vertical Grip, Extended Medium Mag and Padded Stock; the grip and stock trade away ADS speed.
use.zh: 它是唯一的三连发步枪，适合中远距离短点射，乱扫很吃亏。社区评级大致是 PvP 为 B、PvE 为 C：对 ARC 的穿甲只有中等，要打 ARC 背面的弱点。常见配件是补偿器、垂直握把、中型扩容弹匣和减震枪托，握把与枪托会拖慢开镜。

obtain.en: Craft Arpeggio I at the Gunsmith (level 2) from common Mechanical Components and Simple Gun Parts, or take the one from the Broken Monument quest. Tian Wen also sells it, but at 16,500 coins and limited stock, crafting is far cheaper.
obtain.zh: 在武器工作台（2 级）制作“三连奏 I”，材料是常见的机械元件和简易枪械零件制作，或领取任务“破败的纪念”的奖励。天玟也卖，但要 16500 钱币且限购，自己做便宜得多。

tips.en: Tier III is the sweet spot if materials are tight; Tier IV costs a Medium Gun Parts to reach and gives the biggest fire-rate and reload jump.
tips.zh: 材料紧张时升到 III 级就够用；IV 级要多花中型枪械零件，但射速和换弹提升最大。

tips.en: Repairs cost the same part types as the gun is worth in recycling, so keep it as a throwaway mid-tier loadout rather than a gun you baby.
tips.zh: 修理耗材与回收所得同类，适合当随便带的中档配装，不必太心疼。

verdict.en: An armor-breaking heavy-ammo rifle: excellent against big ARC and bosses, but a poor PvP pick that burns expensive ammo.
verdict.zh: 重型弹破甲步枪：打大型 ARC 和首领很强，PvP 表现差且费弹。

use.en: Its job is armored ARC. After the 1.26.0 buff it hits Rocketeers, Shredders and Bombardiers hard, and is only okay against Hornets and Wasps where heavy ammo is wasted. In PvP its time-to-kill trails Anvil and Venator, and the same buff slightly raised light-shield TTK, so most players use a medium-ammo rifle for duels. Common builds are a Muzzle Brake or Compensator, Angled Grip and Padded Stock. Ammo supply, not durability, is the limit: bring a full heavy stack.
use.zh: 它的定位是对付带装甲的 ARC。1.26.0 加强后，打火箭手、粉碎者和投弹手很猛，打马蜂和黄蜂则浪费重型弹。PvP 里击杀速度不如铁砧和“复仇者”，多数人对枪会换成中型弹步枪。常见配置是枪口制退器或补偿器、直角握把和减震枪托。限制你的是弹药而非耐久，出发前备满一组重型弹。

obtain.en: Learn the Bettina blueprint, then craft it at the Gunsmith (level 3); it is not sold by traders. Bettina I is also a reward from the quest Sizing Things Up, and Bettina III from Nothing Gained, so quest players can skip the build.
obtain.zh: 先学会贝蒂娜蓝图，再在武器工作台（3 级）制作，商人不出售。任务“审时度势”奖励贝蒂娜 I，“不入虎穴”奖励贝蒂娜 III，做这些任务可以省掉制作。

amplified.en: Amplifying needs a Mk. IV (Epic) Amplification Module and a Tier IV gun, and the choice is permanent. Players rate Semi-Auto into X-Rounds highest for armored ARC (explosive rounds, extra armor damage). Bigger Mag keeps full-auto and raises the mag from 22 to 37 for boss dumps. Repairs run on Amplified Fragments and get steep: 17 for the base, 27 for Bigger Mag or Semi-Auto, 35 for X-Rounds.
amplified.zh: 增强需要 Mk. IV（史诗）增强模块和 IV 级枪，选择不可更改。玩家最看好“半自动改装 + 爆裂弹”用来打装甲 ARC（爆裂弹对装甲伤害更高）。“扩容弹匣”保持全自动，弹匣由 22 发升到 37 发，适合对首领倾泻。修理要消耗增强碎片，价格很高：基础款 17，扩容或半自动款 27，爆裂弹款 35。

tips.en: Solo, save it for confirmed heavy ARC fights; in a squad let one player carry the armor-breaking gun.
tips.zh: 单人时只在确认遇到重型 ARC 时再带；组队时让一人负责破甲即可。

tips.en: Repair needs Advanced Mechanical Components and Heavy Gun Parts every time, so unamplified Tier IV is far cheaper to run than any Amplified version.
tips.zh: 每次修理都要高级机械元件和重型枪械零件；未增强的 IV 级运营成本比任何增强版低得多。

verdict.en: A cheap, accurate light-ammo PvP starter that is useless against armored ARC; the Amplified Full-Auto version is its best upgrade.
verdict.zh: 便宜准确的轻型弹 PvP 入门枪，打装甲 ARC 基本没用；增强后的全自动版最值得升。

use.en: Quick, stable and light-ammo efficient, it suits close to medium-range duels with controlled shots. Armor penetration is Very Weak, so carry something else for ARC. Its fire rate was capped at 450 RPM in 1.11.0 after macro abuse, and base damage dropped from 10 to 8.5 in 1.17.0, so it is viable but no longer automatic. Guides suggest angled grips, muzzle brakes and bigger mags.
use.zh: 射击快、稳定、轻型弹省，适合近中距离控制点射对枪。对 ARC 的穿甲极弱，打 ARC 要另带枪。1.11.0 因宏滥用把射速上限砍到 450 RPM，1.17.0 又把基础伤害从 10 降到 8.5，所以仍可用，但不再是无脑之选。攻略常推荐斜握把、制退器和扩容弹匣。

obtain.en: It is the easiest rifle to access: craft it at Gunsmith or Workbench level 1, buy it from Tian Wen for 2,520 coins, or find it in raids. Some raiders also spawn with it in a free loadout.
obtain.zh: 这是最容易拿到的步枪：武器工作台或工作台 1 级即可制作，天玟处 2520 钱币可买，局内也能捡到，部分免费配装也会带。

amplified.en: Needs only a cheap Mk. I (Common) module. Full-Auto, or Anti-Shield plus Full-Auto, is the PvP pick players name; X-Rounds is the PvE option and lifts armor penetration to Moderate. Repairs are costly for such a cheap gun: 17 Amplified Fragments for Full-Auto or Anti-Shield, 27 for both, 15 for X-Rounds.
amplified.zh: 只需便宜的 Mk. I（普通）模块。玩家推荐的 PvP 路线是全自动，或破盾强化加全自动；爆裂弹偏 PvE，会把穿甲提升到中等。对一把便宜枪来说修理很贵：全自动或破盾款 17 个增强碎片，两者兼备 27，爆裂弹款 15。

tips.en: Tier IV Kettle sells for 5,000 but recycles into only Mechanical Components and Simple Gun Parts, so sell spare ones.
tips.zh: 水壶 IV 售价 5000，回收只得机械元件和简易枪械零件，多余的直接卖掉。

tips.en: Do not amplify it unless you will really use it: a single repair of the best variant costs more than the base rifle is worth to most players.
tips.zh: 除非真会常用，不要增强：最高档变体修一次的成本，对多数玩家来说比整把基础枪还贵。

verdict.en: A cheap, cheerful budget rifle that is fine to learn on, but outclassed in PvP and awkward to reload.
verdict.zh: 便宜好用的入门步枪，PvP里吃亏，换弹也别扭。

use.en: Best at close to mid range in short fights. It loads only 2 rounds per reload step, so a long reload mid-fight is deadly; top the mag up between fights. Community tier lists put it at C: fine as a cheap kit, not a pick for contested PvP. Tier IV's 24-round mag helps a lot, and repairs stay cheap through Tier III.
use.zh: 适合中近距离的短促交火。它每次只能装填2发，战斗中途换弹很危险，所以交火间隙就把弹匣补满。社区强度榜把它放在C档：作为低成本配装不错，但不适合高强度PvP。IV级的24发弹匣改善明显，III级以前维修也很便宜。

obtain.en: Common in weapon crates and loot rooms; one guide points to the eastern sectors and red towers on Dam Battlegrounds and the Hydroponic Dome Complex. The Gunsmith L1 can craft it, and Picking Up The Pieces rewards a Rattler III.
obtain.zh: 武器箱和战利品房间里很常见；有攻略推荐大坝战场的东部区域和红色高塔，以及水培穹顶综合体。武器工作台1级即可制造，任务“积少成多”还会奖励一把响尾蛇 III。

amplified.en: Amplified Rattler (unlocked via the Gunsmith, Research Station and an Amplification Module) offers More Reload, Drum Mag (+40 rounds, but more recoil and slower aim) and Incendiary Rounds (burn damage over time). Players mostly rate Drum Mag first, More Reload as the safe pick, and Incendiary the least. Repairs need Amplified Fragments: 7 at the base, 35 for the full tree.
amplified.zh: 增强型“响尾蛇”需要武器工作台、研究站和增强模块解锁，可选高效装填、弹鼓弹匣（+40发，但后坐力更大、瞄准更慢）和燃烧弹（持续灼烧）。玩家最看好弹鼓弹匣，高效装填求稳，燃烧弹评价最低。维修要消耗增强碎片：基础款7个，满配树35个。

tips.en: The 2.0 patch notes list no Rattler changes; the last known buff was in 1.7.0 (base mag 10 to 12).
tips.zh: 2.0更新日志没有响尾蛇的改动；已知最近一次加强在1.7.0（基础弹匣由10增至12）。

tips.en: Spare Rattler IIIs are better recycled than sold: they return Mechanical Components and Simple Gun Parts, worth more than the 5000 coin sale.
tips.zh: 多余的“响尾蛇” III回收能得到机械元件和简易枪械零件，比卖5000钱币更划算。

tips.en: Amplified Rattlers drop to 10% durability if you die, so budget for fragments before you bring the 35-fragment build.
tips.zh: 增强型“响尾蛇”在你死亡后耐久会掉到10%，带满配款出战前先算好碎片够不够修。

verdict.en: One of the best all-round assault rifles for PvP, but the blueprint is a grind and repairs use pricey parts.
verdict.zh: PvP表现最好的突击步枪之一，但蓝图难刷，维修材料也不便宜。

use.en: Stable, full-auto and usable at almost any range, which is why tier lists rate it S in PvP and B in PvE. Each upgrade cuts recoil and reload time substantially, so Tier IV is where it really shines. It hits for modest damage per bullet, so it is no heavy ARC killer.
use.zh: 稳定、全自动，几乎任何距离都能用，因此强度榜给PvP评S、PvE评B。每次升级都明显降低后坐力和换弹时间，IV级才是完全体。单发伤害一般，不适合当对付ARC的主力。

obtain.en: Learn the Tempest Blueprint, then craft at Gunsmith L3. It is a random drop from weapon cases, raider caches and security lockers; guides suggest Buried City night raids or First Wave Caches during a Hurricane condition (older tips, check current events).
obtain.zh: 先学会风暴蓝图，再到武器工作台3级制造。蓝图是武器箱、掠袭者储物箱和安保柜里的随机掉落；有攻略推荐掩埋废城夜间突袭，或飓风条件下的头波物资箱（较早的建议，请以当前活动为准）。

tips.en: Repairs get dear at Tier IV (5 Advanced Mechanical Components and 4 Medium Gun Parts), so only bring IV when you plan to fight.
tips.zh: IV级维修要5个高级机械元件和4个中型枪械零件，打算认真交战时再带。

tips.en: Recycling returns exactly what a repair costs, so a worn spare is never wasted.
tips.zh: 回收所得与一次维修的材料相当，用旧的备用枪也不亏。

tips.en: No Tempest balance changes appear in the 2.0 patch notes.
tips.zh: 2.0更新日志里没有风暴的改动。

verdict.en: A close-range bullet hose with a huge mag; fun and good for PvE, but handling and accuracy keep it out of serious PvP.
verdict.zh: 近距离的大弹匣火力泼洒枪；PvE好用，但操控和精度限制了PvP。

use.en: Fire crouched, since it is only accurate then, and stay within close quarters. Players report it shreds raiders at short range but has slow pull-out and aim speed. Rated C in PvP and B in PvE. It eats Medium Ammo fast, so bring plenty or let a squadmate carry it.
use.zh: 只有蹲下时才准，请蹲射并保持近距离作战。玩家反映它在近处能迅速撕碎对手，但拔枪和开镜都慢。PvP评C，PvE评B。它很耗中型弹药，要多带，或交给队友使用。

obtain.en: Craft it at Gunsmith L2 after learning the blueprint; Tian Wen also sells Tier I for 21000 coins (limit 1). Guides name blueprint spots at Marano Station, South Swamp Outpost, Pale Apartments, Testing Annex and Water Treatment Complex.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在武器工作台2级制造；天玟也出售I级，售价21000钱币（限购1）。攻略提到的蓝图地点有马拉诺站、南沼泽前哨、苍白公寓、测试附楼和水处理综合体。

tips.en: Repairs are cheap (1 Advanced Mechanical Component and 1 Medium Gun Part at Tier I), but ammo is the real cost.
tips.zh: 维修便宜（I级只要1个高级机械元件和1个中型枪械零件），真正花钱的是弹药。

tips.en: Tier IV's 45% faster reload matters, since a 90-round mag still empties quickly.
tips.zh: IV级换弹快45%很值，90发弹匣也很快打空。

tips.en: A suppressor will not fully silence it. No 2.0 balance changes are listed.
tips.zh: 消音器无法完全消除它的枪声。2.0没有列出平衡改动。

verdict.en: A strong mid-range energy burst rifle for PvP and armored ARC, but it drinks ammo and the Amplified versions are brutal to repair.
verdict.zh: 中距离能量连发步枪，PvP和打装甲ARC都强，但费弹，增强型修理极贵。

use.en: Fires two-round bursts with Strong ARC armor penetration, good stability and long falloff range. Players compare it to the Il Toro: Toro kills in about two bursts at its best range, Aphelion needs about three, but Aphelion holds up better at distance. Play patiently, fire aimed bursts instead of spraying, and bring spare Energy Clips. A vertical grip tightens the pair of shots. It is also a respected anti-ARC pick.
use.zh: 两连发，对ARC护甲穿透强，稳定性好、有效距离远。玩家常拿它和“公牛”比：“公牛”最佳距离约两个连发击杀，“远日点”约要三个，但远距离更稳。别扫射，打瞄准的点射，多带能量弹匣。竖握把能让两发更集中；打ARC也很好用。

obtain.en: No trader sells it. You need the Aphelion blueprint, which drops from the Matriarch (the drop was moved to Stella Montis in patch 1.7.0, so check there first), then craft it at Gunsmith level 3 with a Matriarch Reactor. The quest Furtive Meetings also rewards one.
obtain.zh: 商人不卖。需要“远日点”蓝图，来自“族母”（1.7.0起蓝图掉落改到星辰山，先去那里找），再在武器工作台3级用“族母”反应堆制作。任务“秘密集会”也会奖励一把。

amplified.en: Amplified is the Mk. V route: Bigger Mag, Charged Burst (hold to charge), Increased Burst (a refined Charged Burst) and Incendiary Rounds (extra burn damage). Guides suggest taking all four, but I found no hands-on player verdicts yet. Every perk stacks repair cost: the plain Amplified needs 22 Amplified Fragments to repair, the full build 61.
amplified.zh: 增强型是Mk. V路线：扩容弹匣、蓄力连发（按住蓄力）、强化连发（蓄力连发的进阶版）和燃烧弹（附加灼烧伤害）。攻略建议四个全点，但目前还没找到玩家实测评价。每加一个词条修理费都上涨：基础增强型22个增强碎片，全词条要61个。

tips.en: Ammo use is the real cost: kills take extra bursts, so carry more clips than you would for a Toro.
tips.zh: 真正的成本是耗弹：击杀要多打几个连发，弹匣要比带“托罗”时多备。

tips.en: Don't send a full Amplified build into a risky raid: repair is 61 Amplified Fragments, while recycling returns only 35.
tips.zh: 别带全词条增强型冒险：修理要61个增强碎片，回收才返35个。

tips.en: The base rifle can't be upgraded through tiers; the Amplified path starts from it directly.
tips.zh: 基础款无法升阶，增强型直接从它升级。

verdict.en: Cheap, hard-hitting single-shot rifle that is the best budget answer to ARC armor, but the one-round reload punishes misses in close fights.
verdict.zh: 便宜的单发重炮，是对付ARC护甲的最佳平价选择，但近战打偏就要挨打。

use.en: Break-action, one round per reload, Heavy Ammo, Strong ARC penetration and a 2.5x headshot multiplier. Use it from distance on armored ARC and for opportunistic headshots on players; PvP ceiling is lower than pricier rifles and guides disagree (S to B tier). Always pair it with a fast backup like the Stitcher and drop the Ferro if someone rushes you.
use.zh: 折枪式，每发都要装填，用重型弹药，ARC护甲穿透强，爆头倍率2.5x。适合远距离打装甲ARC、对玩家找机会爆头；PvP上限不如昂贵步枪，各攻略评价从S到B不一。务必带“钉机”之类的速射副武器，被贴脸就别用“生铁”。

obtain.en: Craft Ferro I at a Workbench with Gunsmith level 1 for a handful of Metal and Rubber Parts, or buy it from Tian Wen. Ferro IV comes from the quest The Right Tool, and the Free Loadout can include one.
obtain.zh: 在工作台（武器工作台1级）用少量金属零件和橡胶零件制作生铁 I，或向天玟购买。生铁 IV是任务“正确工具”的奖励，免费装备也可能带一把。

tips.en: Upgrades are cheap (mostly Metal Parts), and each tier cuts reload time, which matters most for this gun. Ferro IV cuts it by 39%.
tips.zh: 升级便宜（主要是金属零件），每阶都缩短装填时间，这对它最关键。生铁 IV缩短39%。

tips.en: A compensator tightens shots; a silencer helps if you don't want to draw ARC attention.
tips.zh: 补偿器能让弹着更集中；不想引来ARC时可加消音器。

tips.en: Repair is cheap at every tier, so it is a low-risk loadout when you don't want to lose a good gun.
tips.zh: 各阶修理都便宜，不想亏好枪时是低风险之选。

verdict.en: Accurate lever-action rifle for medium to long range: great against players and flyers, weak against heavy armor and up close.
verdict.zh: 精准的杠杆步枪，中远距离打玩家和飞行ARC很强，打重甲和贴身战较弱。

use.en: Medium Ammo, 8-round magazine, high headshot damage and pinpoint accuracy when standing or crouched. Players like it at 50-100 m, and it can shoot thrusters off Wasps and handle small ARC like Pops. Moderate armor penetration means it struggles on Bastions, and close-range weapons such as the Vulcano beat it. A Silencer II or better keeps shots quiet; a 2x marksman sight suits its range.
use.zh: 中型弹药，弹匣8发，爆头伤害高，站立或蹲下时极精准。玩家常在50到100米使用，可以打掉黄蜂的推进器，也能处理“爆爆”等小型ARC。护甲穿透一般，打“堡垒”吃力，近距离会被“火山”这类武器压制。消音器 II以上能保持静音，2倍瞄准镜很适合它的射程。

obtain.en: Buy Renegade I from Tian Wen (one per day, 21,000 coins) or craft it at Gunsmith level 3. The quests Wires Crossed and Back on Top each reward one. If you want it cheap, take the quest copies.
obtain.zh: 向天玟购买叛逆 I（每日限1把，21000钱币），或在武器工作台3级制作。任务“线路交错”和“重占上风”各奖励一把，想省钱就靠任务拿。

amplified.en: Amplified needs the Mk. III module, Gunsmith and Research Station level 4, and the Renegade at tier IV. Choices are More Reload (loads more rounds per reload) and Scoped (adds a scope). Guides rate Scoped highly for clearing flyers and long-range PvP and list both together as the recommended path, but it is the pricier one: 33 Amplified Fragments to repair.
amplified.zh: 增强需要Mk. III模块、武器工作台和研究站4级，且叛逆升到IV。可选高效装填（每次装填多装子弹）和加装瞄准镜。攻略称瞄准镜适合清飞行ARC和远程PvP，并推荐两个都选，但修理要33个增强碎片，花费最高。

tips.en: Tier upgrades are cheap (1 Advanced Mechanical Component plus 2 Medium Gun Parts each) and add up to 75% fire rate, so upgrade before you amplify.
tips.zh: 升阶便宜（每阶1个高级机械元件加2个中型枪械零件），最高加75%射速，先升满再考虑增强。

tips.en: Renegade IV repair costs 3 Advanced Mechanical Components plus 3 Medium Gun Parts; an Amplified one with no perks is much cheaper (13 fragments) than the full build.
tips.zh: 叛逆 IV修理要3个高级机械元件和3个中型枪械零件；不选词条的增强型修理仅13个碎片，比全词条便宜得多。

tips.en: Perk values come partly from preview builds, so check the in-game stats before committing.
tips.zh: 词条数值部分来自测试版，投入前先看游戏内数据。

verdict.en: A cheap, accurate light-ammo sidearm for finishing raiders, but weak against ARC and rated only a niche PvP pick.
verdict.zh: 便宜准头好的轻型弹药副武器，适合补刀玩家，打ARC乏力。

use.en: Fast semi-auto clicking with a 12-round mag makes it a decent backup for close fights against raiders. Against ARC its armor penetration is very weak, so bring a real primary for machines. PvE guides call it fine for light farming runs; PvP tier lists put it around C-tier. Players favor an extended light mag and a Muzzle Brake II to keep follow-up shots on target.
use.zh: 半自动连点配12发弹匣，近距离对付玩家的副武器够用。ARC护甲穿透极弱，对付机器要另带主武器。PvE攻略认为适合轻量搜刮，PvP排行多把它放在C档。玩家常配扩容轻型弹匣和枪口制退器 II，让连射更稳。

obtain.en: Learn the blueprint (Burletta I is the Industrial Espionage reward), then craft at Gunsmith level 1. Tian Wen sells it for 8,700 coins, 3 a day, which is steep next to the cheap craft. It also turns up in ordinary loot. Burletta III is the Snap and Salvage reward.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在武器工作台 1 级制作（“工业间谍”任务奖励布尔莱塔 I）。天玟每天限购 3 把、要价 8700 钱币，比自己制作贵得多。普通战利品里也能捡到。布尔莱塔 III 是“拍照并拆解回收”的奖励。

amplified.en: Unlocking needs the Outpost, Gunsmith 4 and Research Station 4, plus a Mk. II module. Burst Fire (then Increased Burst) is the safe pick: players say it has almost no downside. Full-Auto trades headshot damage and recoil control for fire rate, and some players found it out-DPSed by a plain Bobcat. Sprint Shooting is an optional add-on.
amplified.zh: 解锁需要哨站、武器工作台 4 级、研究站 4 级和 Mk. II 模块。玩家最推荐连发模式（再升强化连发），几乎没有副作用。全自动以爆头伤害和后坐力控制换射速，有玩家测出伤害输出还不如普通“山猫”。冲刺射击可按需追加。

tips.en: Amplified repairs scale hard: plain Burst needs 21 Amplified Fragments, the full Burst + Increased Burst + Sprint Shooting build 41. Pick perks you will actually use.
tips.zh: 增强版修理开销很大：只选连发模式需 21 个增强碎片，连发 + 强化连发 + 冲刺射击要 41 个，只选真正用得上的。

tips.en: Crafting I is cheap and upgrades cost mostly Mechanical Components, so the Tian Wen price is not worth paying.
tips.zh: 制作 I 阶便宜，升级主要吃机械元件，不值得花钱找天玟买。

verdict.en: A silenced stealth sidearm that is dirt cheap to run, but clumsy in a real fight and ranked bottom-tier for PvP.
verdict.zh: 自带消音、成本极低的潜行副武器，正面对枪很吃力，PvP 垫底。

use.en: The slide-action cycling slows follow-up shots, and ARC armor penetration is very weak, so treat it as a quiet loot-run gun that will not wake the map. One tier list calls it D-tier for PvP. It has no muzzle or grip slot, only a light magazine mod.
use.zh: 拉栓式击发让连射很慢，对ARC的护甲穿透极弱，更适合安静搜刮、不惊动周围。有排行把它列为 PvP 的 D 档。它没有枪口和握把槽位，只能装轻型弹匣。

obtain.en: The cheapest gun to start with: craft Hairpin I at a Workbench or Gunsmith from Metal Parts and Plastic Parts. Tian Wen also sells it, and weapon crates on Blue Gate, Dam Battlegrounds and The Spaceport can hold one. It is the one Common weapon not in a free loadout.
obtain.zh: 入门成本最低：在工作台或武器工作台用金属零件和塑料零件制作发夹 I。天玟也出售，蓝门、大坝战场、太空港的武器箱里可能刷出。它是唯一不在免费装备包里的普通品质武器。

amplified.en: Needs the Outpost, Gunsmith 4, Research Station 4 and a Mk. I module. Semi-Auto (+150% fire rate, worse headshots and spread) with Sprint Shooting is the aggressive pick; a preview squad running it was dangerous up close. Tracker Rounds reveal a hit target for 5 seconds, and Incendiary adds burn damage; those two are exclusive.
amplified.zh: 解锁需要哨站、武器工作台 4 级、研究站 4 级和 Mk. I 模块。半自动（射速 +150%，爆头与散布变差）搭配冲刺射击是激进路线，预览时有小队用它近战很危险。追踪弹可让命中目标暴露 5 秒，燃烧弹增加灼烧伤害，两者互斥。

tips.en: Do not pour materials into tiers II to IV for fighting; the gun stays weak against ARC. Upgrade only if you love the silent playstyle.
tips.zh: 别为了战斗往 II 到 IV 阶投入材料，打ARC依然乏力；只有爱潜行玩法才值得升级。

tips.en: Amplified repairs are the real cost: Semi-Auto + Sprint Shooting needs 27 Amplified Fragments, more than a Hairpin ever earns back.
tips.zh: 增强版的修理才是大头：半自动 + 冲刺射击需 27 个增强碎片，远超“发夹”的价值。

verdict.en: A top-rated PvP pistol thanks to Twin Shot, though only a mid pick for PvE and not amplifiable in 2.0.
verdict.zh: 双发射击让它成为 PvP 顶级手枪，PvE 表现一般。

use.en: Each trigger pull fires two projectiles but uses one round, so it hits hard at close to medium range with Medium Ammo. The wiki rates it S-tier for PvP and B-tier for PvE; Moderate armor penetration keeps it behind real ARC killers. Most players run it as a sidearm with an extended medium mag and a grip or brake for recoil.
use.zh: 每次扣扳机射出两发弹丸却只耗一发弹药，用中型弹药在近中距离火力凶猛。社区维基给 PvP 评 S、PvE 评 B；护甲穿透为中等，打ARC不如专业武器。多数玩家当副武器用，配扩容中型弹匣和握把或制退器压后坐力。

obtain.en: No fixed spawn and no trader sells it: you need the blueprint, then Gunsmith level 2. It drops from weapon crates and Raider Caches; guides point to Dam Battlegrounds crate routes and locked or breachable rooms, and night raids raise rare blueprint odds. Protect the blueprint in a safe pocket.
obtain.zh: 没有固定刷新点，商人也不卖：需要蓝图并有武器工作台 2 级。可从武器箱和奇袭者箱获得；攻略推荐大坝战场的武器箱路线、上锁或可破拆的房间，夜间突袭稀有蓝图概率更高。把蓝图放进安全口袋。

tips.en: It was nerfed in patch 1.3.0 (smaller fire-rate bonuses from upgrades), so tips from before that are stale. It was later nerfed again for damage and headshots per the wiki history.
tips.zh: 1.3.0 版本削弱过（升级带来的射速加成变小），更早的攻略已过时；维基记录还显示其伤害和爆头倍率也被下调。

tips.en: IV repair costs 3 Advanced Mechanical Components, and the gun sells for 17,000. Fine for a main sidearm, wasteful to leave a worn one in the bag.
tips.zh: IV 阶修理要 3 个高级机械元件，而售价为 17000；当主副武器可以，磨损的别留在背包。

verdict.en: A heavy-hitting hand cannon with strong ARC penetration, but slow handling and costly Heavy Ammo.
verdict.zh: 重型手炮，对ARC穿透强，但手感迟缓，重型弹药不便宜。

use.en: One accurate shot does the work at medium range, and Strong armor penetration makes it a real ARC answer. Close up it feels clunky because of the low fire rate. Top PvP tier lists rank it S. Players mostly mount a Compensator III for accuracy at range, or a silencer if they want to keep aggro down.
use.zh: 中距离一发准确命中就能解决问题，强穿透让它成为对付ARC的可靠选择。近距离因射速低显得笨重。PvP 排行里排 S 档。玩家多装补偿器 III 提升远距准度，想少引怪则换消音器。

obtain.en: 2.0 raised it to Rare, and Tian Wen no longer sells it; it now rotates through the weekly Nomadic Envoy. Otherwise find the blueprint, mainly in Raider Caches and weapon boxes on any map, then craft at Gunsmith level 2. A Rising Tide and Communication Hideout reward Anvil II and III.
obtain.zh: 2.0 把它提升为稀有，天玟不再出售，改入每周游牧使团轮换。否则需要找蓝图，任何地图的奇袭者箱和武器箱最常出，之后在武器工作台 2 级制作。“涨潮”和“通讯隐蔽处”分别奖励铁砧 II 和 III。

amplified.en: Needs a Mk. III module on top of the usual Outpost, Gunsmith 4 and Research Station 4. X-Rounds adds explosive damage that is rated for armor and raiders; guides call it the PvE pick but note a lower headshot multiplier. Anvil Splitter, once a tech mod, now breaks each bullet into 4 weaker pellets.
amplified.zh: 除哨站、武器工作台 4 级、研究站 4 级外还需 Mk. III 模块。爆裂弹带来爆炸伤害，对护甲和玩家都有加成，攻略视为 PvE 首选，但爆头倍率降低。铁砧分流器原是科技模组，现在让每发子弹分成 4 枚弱化弹丸。

tips.en: Repairs on the Amplified version cost 13 Amplified Fragments (X-Rounds 21, Splitter 23), so keep a plain Anvil IV for routine runs.
tips.zh: 增强版修理需 13 个增强碎片（爆裂弹 21、分裂弹 23），日常出战带普通铁砧 IV 更划算。

tips.en: Old Anvil Splitter mods no longer drop; recycle leftovers into Amplified Fragments to cover repairs.
tips.zh: 旧的铁砧分流器模组不再掉落，剩下的可回收成增强碎片，用来修理。

verdict.en: A strong close-range energy shotgun, but the blueprint is a grind and every Energy Clip costs real money.
verdict.zh: 近战很强的能量霰弹枪，但蓝图难刷，能量弹匣也很烧钱。

use.en: Two modes: hipfire is a wide short-range cone that clears grouped ARC, ADS is a tight beam that reaches far further. Players rate the ADS beam very highly against Vaporizers and Shredders and in close PvP, where it strips a heavy shield in two hits. It uses its own Energy Clips, so you can't share ammo with another gun. It cannot be upgraded and has no mod slots listed.
use.zh: 有两种模式：腰射是近距离的宽扇面，适合清成群 ARC；瞄准是更远的聚焦光束。玩家普遍认为聚焦光束打“汽化者”和“粉碎者”以及近距离 PvP 都很强，两下就能打穿重型护盾。它用独立的能量弹匣，不能和其他枪共用弹药，也无法升级。

obtain.en: The blueprint is a random drop from breaching Assessors, and only while the Close Scrutiny map condition is active (hourly rotation on Dam, Buried City, Spaceport, Blue Gate; not Stella Montis). Each of an Assessor's three chambers is a separate roll. Crafting needs Gunsmith 3, and the Vaporizer Regulators come from the same event.
obtain.zh: 蓝图只会在“严密排查”地图条件下，从破门的评估者容器里随机掉落（大坝战场、掩埋废城、太空港、蓝门每小时轮换，星辰山没有）。每个评估者的三个舱室各算一次掉落。制作需要武器工作台 3 级，“汽化者”调节器也在同一活动中获得。

amplified.en: There is no Amplified version. The only 2.0 change was a bug fix that lets it destroy the yellow weak points inside a Harvester; it was not nerfed.
amplified.zh: 没有增强型。2.0 对它只有一处修复：现在能打掉“收割者”内部的黄色弱点，并没有被削弱。

tips.en: Clips cost 3,000 coins from Tian Wen, or craft them from Advanced ARC Powercells and Batteries. Stock up before a Close Scrutiny run.
tips.zh: 能量弹匣在天玟处 3000 钱币一个，也可用高级 ARC 电池和电池自制，严密排查前先备足。

tips.en: Repairs cost 2 Magnetic Accelerators and a Shredder Gyro, the same parts you need to craft it, so don't run it at low durability.
tips.zh: 修理需要 2 个磁力加速器和 1 个“粉碎者”陀螺仪，正是制作它的材料，别带着低耐久进局。

tips.en: Recycling gives only 2 Magnetic Accelerators for a 27,500-coin item; sell it instead if you ever drop out of the build.
tips.zh: 回收只能拿 2 个磁力加速器，而它能卖 27500 钱币，不用时直接卖掉更划算。

verdict.en: Cheap, hard-hitting PvP shotgun for the early game, but weak against ARC armor, so carry a second gun.
verdict.zh: 便宜、近战伤害高的 PvP 霰弹枪，但打 ARC 装甲吃力，需要备一把副武器。

use.en: Two or three body shots kill most raiders up close, and fully built it can down a medium-shield player in two shots within 7-8 m. Falloff is sharp and the pump reloads one shell at a time, so fight inside corners. Common mods are Shotgun Choke III, Extended Shotgun Mag III and a Lightweight Stock; recoil barely matters, so the grip is optional.
use.zh: 近距离两三发就能放倒大多数玩家，配满后在 7 到 8 米内两枪可打倒中等护盾的对手。衰减很厉害，换弹是逐发上膛，所以要贴近拐角作战。常见配件是霰弹枪收束器 III、霰弹扩容弹匣 III 和轻型枪托；后坐力影响不大，握把可选。

obtain.en: Cheapest route is crafting at Gunsmith 1 once you have the blueprint. Tian Wen sells it for 15,000 coins (max 3), triple its sell value, so buy only if you lack the blueprint. Unexpected Initiative also rewards one.
obtain.zh: 最省钱的是拿到蓝图后在武器工作台 1 级自制。天玟 15000 钱币出售（限购 3 把），是售价的三倍，没蓝图时才买。任务“计划不如变化快”也会送一把。

amplified.en: Unlock it through the Research Station project Solid-Core Casting Tech, then upgrade from Il Toro IV. Slug Rounds turns the pellets into one heavy slug with strong armor penetration, making it a mid-range gun for PvE and PvP; players rate it above More Reload, which only speeds reloading. Perks are permanent. Repairs cost 10/20/30 Amplified Fragments, so take only one perk unless you farm them.
amplified.zh: 在研究站完成“实心铸造技术”研究项目解锁，再用“公牛” IV 升级。独头弹把散弹变成一发重弹，对装甲穿透很强，能在中距离兼顾 PvE 和 PvP，玩家评价高于只加快装填的高效装填。强化一旦选定无法更改。修理要 10、20、30 个增强碎片，除非能大量刷碎片，否则只选一个强化。

tips.en: The nerf came in patch 1.20.0 (March): pellet damage, fire rate, spread, reload and falloff were all worsened. The 2.0 notes do not touch it.
tips.zh: 削弱发生在 1.20.0（3 月）版本：伤害、射速、散布、装填和衰减都变差。2.0 没有再改它。

tips.en: Il Toro IV repairs cost 5 Mechanical Components and 5 Simple Gun Parts, cheap enough to keep running it.
tips.zh: 公牛 IV 修理只要 5 个机械元件和 5 个简易枪械零件，用起来不心疼。

tips.en: Upgrading to IV needs one Heavy Gun Part plus four Mechanical Components at each of the last two steps.
tips.zh: 升到 IV 的最后两步各需要 1 个重型枪械零件和若干机械元件。

verdict.en: Fast semi-auto shotgun that rules close-range PvP, but is weak against ARC and eats expensive parts to repair.
verdict.zh: 近战 PvP 很强的半自动霰弹枪，打 ARC 乏力，修理耗材也贵。

use.en: Tier lists put it at A in PvP and B in PvE. It deals big burst damage in tight spaces, but falloff is sharp and some players find it inconsistent unless fully upgraded and modded. Reload and fire rate improve noticeably at III and IV. Players pair it with Shotgun Choke III and Extended Shotgun Mag III; the magazine mod is the key fix. Bring another weapon for ARC.
use.zh: 排行榜里 PvP 为 A、PvE 为 B。狭窄空间里爆发很高，但衰减严重，没升满、没配好时有人觉得不稳定。III 和 IV 的装填与射速提升明显。玩家常配霰弹枪收束器 III 和霰弹扩容弹匣 III，扩容是最关键的补强。打 ARC 要另带武器。

obtain.en: No trader sells it and no quest hands out the blueprint. One guide points to the Research building in Marano Park, Buried City, but the spawn is not confirmed; hidden raider caches can also hold blueprints. Crafting needs Gunsmith 3 plus an Exodus Module. The quest Into the Fray rewards Vulcano III.
obtain.zh: 商人不出售，任务也不送蓝图。有攻略提到掩埋废城马拉诺公园的研究楼，但并未证实，隐藏的突袭者储物点也可能出蓝图。制作需要武器工作台 3 级和一个离巢模块。任务“投入战斗”奖励火山 III。

amplified.en: There is no Amplified version of the Vulcano.

tips.en: Repairs cost Advanced Mechanical Components and Heavy Gun Parts, 4 of each at tier IV. That is steep, so don't take it into raids you expect to be long.
tips.zh: 修理要高级机械元件和重型枪械零件，IV 阶各 4 个，开销不小，别带进预计会打很久的局。

tips.en: Recycling a IV returns 4 Advanced Mechanical Components and 5 Heavy Gun Parts, more than most players spend upgrading it.
tips.zh: 回收 IV 能拿回 4 个高级机械元件和 5 个重型枪械零件，不想用时回收不亏。

tips.en: No 2.0 change to the Vulcano appears in the official notes.
tips.zh: 官方 2.0 更新说明里没有火山的改动。

verdict.en: A close-range PvP spray gun that only works once fully upgraded; against armored ARC it is close to useless.
verdict.zh: 近距离PvP喷子，升满才好用；打有装甲的ARC基本没用。

use.en: Players rate it A-tier for PvP and C-tier for PvE. The ARC armor penetration is Very Weak, so keep it for raiders and small ARC like Fireballs and Snitches. At tier I the spread is wild: tier IV cuts dispersion and horizontal recoil by 45%, and the usual build adds Vertical Grip III and Extended Light Mag III, with Compensator III or Muzzle Brake II on the muzzle.
use.zh: 玩家把它评为PvP的A级、PvE的C级。对ARC装甲穿透“极弱”，只适合打玩家和火球、告密者这类小型ARC。一阶散布很大，四阶散布和横向后坐力降低45%，常见配置是垂直握把 III 加轻型扩容弹匣 III，枪口用补偿器 III 或枪口制退器 II。

obtain.en: Not sold by traders. Craft it at Gunsmith level 3 after finding the blueprint, which comes from weapon crates and other high-value loot zones; guides call it hard to find. Bobcat IV is also a reward in the Trophy Display project.
obtain.zh: 商人不卖。找到蓝图后在武器工作台3级制作，蓝图多见于武器箱等高价值搜刮点，攻略普遍说不好找。山猫 IV 也是“战利品展示架”项目的奖励。

tips.en: Repair at tier IV costs 5 Advanced Mechanical Components and 4 Light Gun Parts, and it sells for 27000. Do not run it every raid.
tips.zh: 四阶修理要5个高级机械元件和4个轻型枪械零件，而整枪才卖27000，别每局都带。

tips.en: 20 rounds in a fast gun burns Light Ammo quickly, so bring extra magazines.
tips.zh: 20发弹匣打得很快，轻型弹药消耗大，多带备弹。

tips.en: Craft it only to upgrade it: the base gun is the weakest version.
tips.zh: 制作它就是为了升级，基础版是最弱的。

verdict.en: The best all-round SMG of the four: strong in PvP and decent on ARC plating, but the Amplified upgrade is very pricey to repair.
verdict.zh: 四把里最全面的冲锋枪，PvP强、打ARC装甲也尚可；增强版修理很贵。

use.en: Medium Ammo and Moderate armor penetration make it the only one here that works on ARC as well as raiders. Dexerto rates it A in PvP and C in PvE; one guide says it can break a raider shield in under 0.9 seconds. The weak point is recoil on long sprays, so fire in bursts and fit grips and recoil mods.
use.zh: 用中型弹药，护甲穿透为中等，是这几把里唯一对玩家和ARC都能用的。有攻略站评为PvP A级、PvE C级；有攻略称不到0.9秒就能打穿一层奇袭者护盾。弱点是持续扫射后坐力大，建议点射并配握把和稳定类配件。

obtain.en: The blueprint is a random drop. Most reliable: First Wave Raider Caches during the Hurricane condition, or Weapon Cases from the Close Scrutiny operation. Canto I is also a reward from the quests Collision Course and Empathetic Prototypes. Crafting needs Gunsmith level 3.
obtain.zh: 蓝图随机掉落。较稳的来源是“飓风”条件下的第一波奇袭者储物箱，或“严密排查”行动里的武器箱。颂歌 I 也是任务“碰撞航线”和“共情原型机”的奖励。制作需要武器工作台3级。

amplified.en: Three perks: Carbine Conversion (steadier and more accurate), Incendiary Rounds (extra burn damage over time) and Sprint Shooting (fire while sprinting). I found no player ranking; Carbine is the safe pick for PvP. Mixing two perks makes repair cost 31 Amplified Fragments.
amplified.zh: 三种强化：卡宾改装（更稳更准）、燃烧弹（附加持续灼烧伤害）、冲刺射击（可边跑边开火）。没找到玩家的明确排名，打PvP选卡宾改装最稳。两个强化叠加后修理要31个增强碎片。

tips.en: Repair costs: plain Amplified Canto 13 Amplified Fragments, one perk 21 to 23, two perks 31. It only sells for 20800, so think hard before running it.
tips.zh: 修理费：“增强型颂歌”基础款13个增强碎片，单强化21到23个，双强化31个，而整枪只卖20800，出战前三思。

tips.en: Canto IV is the base for the Amplified upgrade, so a fully upgraded Canto is not wasted.
tips.zh: 颂歌 IV 是增强型的升级底子，升满不会白费。

verdict.en: A cheap starter SMG: fine up close early on, but weak armor penetration and low fire rate make it a gun to outgrow.
verdict.zh: 便宜的入门冲锋枪，前期近战够用；穿甲弱、射速低，迟早要换。

use.en: Dexerto puts it at B-tier PvP and D-tier PvE. It hits fairly hard for an SMG but fires slowly and is hard to control, and it does almost nothing to armored ARC. Prioritize recoil and reload upgrades, and carry a second weapon with better penetration. Patch 1.17 nerfed its headshot multiplier and damage; I found no 2.0 changes.
use.zh: 有攻略站评为PvP B级、PvE D级。单发伤害对冲锋枪来说不错，但射速慢、难控制，对有装甲的ARC几乎无效。优先升级后坐力和换弹，再带一把穿透更好的副武器。1.17版削弱过爆头倍率和伤害，2.0没找到改动。

obtain.en: Buy it from Tian Wen, craft it at the Workbench or Gunsmith level 1 (no blueprint noted), or find it in weapon containers near Raider Hatch sites. Stitcher II is a reward for The Right Tool; free loadouts may include it.
obtain.zh: 可向天玟购买，在工作台或武器工作台1级制作，也能在奇袭者暗门附近的武器容器里捡到。钉机 II 是“正确工具”的任务奖励，免费装备也可能带一把。

tips.en: Upgrades and repairs use ordinary Metal and Rubber Parts at low tiers, so keeping it running is cheap compared with the others.
tips.zh: 低阶升级和修理用普通金属零件和橡胶零件，比其他几把便宜得多。

tips.en: At tier IV repair switches to Mechanical Components and Simple Gun Parts; a tier IV sells for 5000, so do not over-invest.
tips.zh: 四阶修理改用机械元件和简易枪械零件，整枪只卖5000，不值得投入太多。

verdict.en: A budget Heavy Ammo revolver that hits hard and pierces ARC armor, but it is inaccurate, short ranged and has no mod slots.
verdict.zh: 预算款重型弹药左轮，伤害高、穿甲好，但不准、射程短，还不能装配件。

use.en: New in 2.0 and the cheaper stand-in for the Anvil, which was bumped to rare. Reviews call it strong against both raiders and ARC at close range, with poor accuracy and hard hip-fire recoil. Aim for the first shots; the 8-round cylinder does not forgive misses. Best as a sidearm or a beginner loadout.
use.zh: 2.0新增，是升为稀有的铁砧的平价替代品。评测称近距离对玩家和ARC都很强，但精度差、腰射后坐力难控。第一发要瞄准，8发弹巢容不下乱打。适合作副武器或新手配置。

obtain.en: Buy Bantam I from Tian Wen (limit 3), claim it at tier 4 of the Frozen Trail Reward Pass, or loot it and its blueprint in containers. Listed spots include Hospital on Buried City and Almatera Station on Pendola Pass.
obtain.zh: 可向天玟购买小钢炮 I（限购3把），霜痕小径奖励通行证4级领取，或在容器里搜到本体和蓝图。搜刮点包括掩埋废城的医院和彭多拉山口的阿尔玛特拉站。

tips.en: Repair and upgrade cost are Mechanical Components and Simple Gun Parts only, cheap next to the other guns here.
tips.zh: 升级和修理只用机械元件和简易枪械零件，比这一批其他枪便宜。

tips.en: No attachments can be fitted, so plan your loadout around its short range.
tips.zh: 不能装配件，配装要围绕它的短射程来定。

verdict.en: A cheap, accurate semi-auto for raider fights, but light ammo makes it a poor ARC killer.
verdict.zh: 便宜好用的半自动步枪，打玩家不错，打ARC乏力。

use.en: Treat it as a budget PvP rifle: high accuracy and low early recoil reward paced single shots, and spread opens up if you dump the magazine. It reloads by swapping a full magazine, so it recovers faster than the Renegade. Against ARC its Weak armor penetration means you burn light ammo for almost no score on armored machines. Fine on light targets only.
use.zh: 当作低成本的PvP步枪：精度高、初始后坐力小，点射最舒服，扫射会明显散布。换整个弹匣的装填比“叛逆”快。弱穿甲意味着打装甲ARC基本是白费轻型弹药，只适合打轻甲目标。

obtain.en: Blueprint is a random container drop on every map (guides list e.g. Dam Hydroponic Dome Complex, Buried City Hospital, Pendola Pass Almatera Station). The quest When Everything Falls gives one copy, and Ermal sells a finished Stiletto IV for a barter. Reward Pass tier 8 also gives a Stiletto I.
obtain.zh: 蓝图在各地图的容器中随机掉落（如大坝水培穹顶、掩埋废城医院、彭多拉山口）。任务“万物崩塌之时”送一把，商人Ermal可用以物易物换成品细剑 IV，通行证8级也给一把细剑 I。

amplified.en: No Amplified version: Stiletto is not in the first 2.0 Amplification pool.
amplified.zh: 没有增强型：细剑不在2.0首批增强武器之列。

tips.en: Upgrades are cheap (Gunsmith 1, basic parts) and add fire rate, reload speed and magazine size; going straight to IV is worth it if you like it.
tips.zh: 武器工作台 1 级升级，材料便宜，提升射速、装填速度和弹匣容量，喜欢就直接升到 IV。

tips.en: Repairs use only basic parts, so it is a good gun to risk in low-stakes raids.
tips.zh: 维修只用基础零件，适合带去低风险对局。

tips.en: Bring a heavier weapon for ARC; do not rely on this one.
tips.zh: 打ARC另带重火力，别指望它。

verdict.en: The best ARC-killing sniper in the game, but a Harvester-grade grind to get and slow to handle.
verdict.zh: 最强的ARC狙击，但获取要打“收割者”，操作偏慢。

use.en: The railgun pierces ARC armor and everything in its line, with near-instant shots and no drop, so one core shot kills most small ARC and big ones fall cheaply. Rated S in PvE and A in PvP: top headshot damage, but long-range headshots are hard, and a miss with only 5 shots and slow handling leaves you exposed up close. Carry a sidearm.
use.zh: 磁轨弹丸可穿透ARC装甲并贯穿路径上所有目标，几乎瞬发、无下坠；打核心一发即可击杀多数小型ARC，大型ARC也很划算。PvE评S、PvP评A：爆头伤害最高，但远距离难命中，仅5发且操作慢，近身落空会很危险，记得带副武器。

obtain.en: Blueprint comes from the Harvester event on Dam Battlegrounds and The Spaceport, from the final containers (some guides say the Queen core). Learn it, then craft at Gunsmith 3 with a Queen Reactor. The Trophy Display project also rewards a finished one.
obtain.zh: 蓝图来自大坝战场和太空港的“收割者”事件，出自最终容器（有攻略称也可从“女王”核心获得）。学会后在武器工作台3级用“女王”反应堆制作。战利品展示架项目也奖励成品。

amplified.en: Perks: Bigger Mag, Scoped, Ergonomic Bolt (cycle bolt while aiming). One guide recommends taking all three. Unlock needs the Research Station: Top Mounted Optics Retrofittings (Snitch Scanners, Pilgrim's Peak) and Action Economy. Repairs are heavy: 22 to 47 Amplified Fragments.
amplified.zh: 增强项：扩容弹匣、加装瞄准镜、人体工学枪栓（瞄准时可拉栓）。有攻略建议三个全选。解锁需研究站：顶置光学瞄具改装（朝圣峰的“告密者”扫描仪）与操作效率。维修很贵：22至47个增强碎片。

tips.en: The base gun repairs for 2 Magnetic Accelerators and 1 Complex Gun Parts, cheap for its power; the Amplified version repairs in Amplified Fragments only.
tips.zh: 基础版维修只要2个磁力加速器和1个复杂枪械零件，相对威力很划算；增强型只能用增强碎片维修。

tips.en: Amplification is permanent on that gun, so pick perks before spending.
tips.zh: 增强一旦施加就固定在该枪上，选之前想清楚。

tips.en: Uses Energy Clips, not common ammo; stock up.
tips.zh: 使用能量弹匣，要提前备足。

verdict.en: A solid mid-tier bolt-action for ARC hunting; fine in PvP only if you land your shots.
verdict.zh: 打ARC的稳妥栓动狙，PvP要枪枪命中才好用。

use.en: Rated S in PvE but only B in PvP: slow bolt and reload punish misses. Medium ammo is easier to find than heavy, and moderate armor penetration is fine for most ARC, though not heavy armor. The scope is always on, which hurts up close. Tier upgrades cut bolt and reload time, so IV matters.
use.zh: PvE评S，PvP仅B：拉栓和装填慢，失手代价大。中型弹药比重型更好找，中等穿甲对多数ARC够用，但打重甲吃力。瞄准镜常开，近战不便。升级会缩短拉栓和装填时间，IV 差别明显。

obtain.en: Blueprint drops from weapon cases, e.g. around the Training Annex on Dam Battlegrounds and Buried City. The quests Exploring Pendola Pass and Boarding The Frigate give one copy. Tian Wen sells it for coins at a high price.
obtain.zh: 蓝图从武器箱掉落，如大坝战场训练楼附近和掩埋废城。任务“探索彭多拉山口”可得一把。天玟出售，但价格很高。

amplified.en: Perks: Anti-Weak Point (more weak-spot damage, less on armor; the PvE pick), Ergonomic Bolt, Tracker Rounds (reveals a hit target for 5s). Needs Action Economy and Targeted Component Trial research. Repairs are costly: up to 34 Amplified Fragments.
amplified.zh: 增强项：弱点专攻（弱点伤害更高、装甲伤害更低，PvE首选）、人体工学枪栓、追踪弹（命中后显示目标5秒）。需研究操作效率与靶向部件试验。维修昂贵：最高34个增强碎片。

tips.en: Repair on the base tiers is cheap; the Amplified version's fragment bill is the real cost.
tips.zh: 基础档维修便宜，增强型的碎片开销才是大头。

tips.en: For heavy ARC armor, a stronger-penetration gun is better.
tips.zh: 面对重甲ARC，换穿甲更强的枪更好。

verdict.en: A beam rifle built to melt armored ARC and bosses; players find it disappointing against other raiders.
verdict.zh: 专打装甲 ARC 和首领的光束步枪，对人表现一般。

use.en: Treat it as a PvE weapon: the 50-round Energy Clip magazine lets you hold the beam on a Bastion, Rocketeer or the Queen without reloading. Guides call it weak against players, with heavy weight, low mobility and no suppression, so it suits corridors and fixed positions. Against the Queen, fire and retreat.
use.zh: 当作 PvE 武器用：50 发能量弹匣可以持续照射“堡垒”“火箭手”乃至女王而不用换弹。多篇攻略认为它对人偏弱：太重、机动差、没有压制力，适合走廊和固定点位。打女王时边打边撤。

obtain.en: Not sold. The blueprint comes from the Harvester event puzzle on Dam Battlegrounds or The Spaceport, where reward containers hold either the Equalizer or Jupiter blueprint. You also need a Queen Reactor, which drops from the Queen during Harvester events. Duplicate blueprints sell for 5,000 coins.
obtain.zh: 商人不卖。蓝图来自大坝战场或太空港的“收割者”事件解谜，奖励箱里是“制裁者”或“木星”的蓝图。制作还需要“女王”反应堆，只在“收割者”事件中击败女王掉落。重复蓝图可卖 5,000 钱币。

amplified.en: Players favor Ramping Damage plus Bigger Mag for ARC and boss DPS, since damage grows the longer the beam stays on target. Anti-Weak Point trades armor damage for weak-point damage and only pays off once armor is stripped. The wiki data shows the stacked variants cost far more Amplified Fragments to repair.
amplified.zh: 玩家推荐“渐增伤害”加“扩容弹匣”，用来打 ARC 和首领，光束照得越久伤害越高。“弱点专攻”牺牲护甲伤害换弱点伤害，要先打掉护甲才划算。叠加多个增强的版本修理要耗费更多增强碎片。

tips.en: Repair is cheap for the base gun, but the Amplified versions need 22 to 54 Amplified Fragments, which is a lot per raid.
tips.zh: 基础版修理便宜，增强版要 22 至 54 个增强碎片，每局都修很肉疼。

tips.en: The base Equalizer cannot be upgraded through tiers; the only step up is the Amplified route.
tips.zh: 基础“制裁者”没有等级升级，唯一的进阶是增强路线。

tips.en: Bring Energy Clips in bulk; they now have a daily trader purchase limit in 2.0.
tips.zh: 多备能量弹；2.0 起商人处能量弹有每日购买上限。

verdict.en: The big-ARC killer, but a bad PvP pick and expensive to feed.
verdict.zh: 对付大型 ARC 的利器，但打人很差，烧钱也快。

use.en: Its grenades only explode on ARC, so it does nothing special against raiders and you lose most duels carrying it. Against Bastions, Rocketeers, Bombardiers, the Matriarch and the Queen it is very strong, and players praise it in Buried City. It is overkill on small ARC, where cheaper options like Blaze grenades are better value.
use.zh: 榴弹只会在 ARC 身上爆炸，对人没有优势，带它打人多半会输。对付“堡垒”“火箭手”“投弹手”、族母和女王时很强，玩家尤其推荐在掩埋废城使用。打小型 ARC 是浪费，用燃烧榴弹之类更划算。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Gunsmith with the blueprint. In 2.0 Tian Wen no longer sells it directly; it moved to the weekly Nomadic Envoy rotation, so check each reset. The Tier I weapon is also a reward for the quest Disrupting the Frigate.
obtain.zh: 用蓝图在武器工作台制作。2.0 中天玟不再直接出售，改为每周“游牧使团”轮换，每次重置后可以去看看。I 级也是任务“干扰护卫者”的奖励。

amplified.en: Mag Reload speeds up reloading the five-round pump magazine. Incendiary Rounds add burn damage over time (about +5 per second) and suit long boss fights. Combining both is the strongest but needs 35 Amplified Fragments per repair, so the single-perk versions are easier to afford.
amplified.zh: “快速装弹”加快五发弹匣的装填。“燃烧弹”给目标附加持续灼烧（约每秒 +5），适合长时间打首领。两者叠加最强，但修一次要 35 个增强碎片，单增强版更省。

tips.en: Ammo is the real cost: launcher ammo prices rose after a damage nerf, so each shot is expensive. Only bring it when you plan to hunt big ARC.
tips.zh: 真正的开销是弹药：伤害削弱后发射器弹药价格上涨，每发都很贵。只在计划猎杀大型 ARC 时再带。

tips.en: Launcher Ammo now has a daily purchase limit at traders in 2.0, so stock up before a long session.
tips.zh: 2.0 起发射器弹药每日限购，长时间游玩前先囤货。

tips.en: Tier IV repair costs 4 Advanced Mechanical Components and 4 Heavy Gun Parts; upgrading to IV is cheap, so it is worth finishing the tiers.
tips.zh: IV 级修理要 4 个高级机械元件和 4 个重型枪械零件；升级到 IV 花费不高，值得升满。

verdict.en: A light, cheap single-shot anti-ARC launcher: a fine backup, not a main weapon.
verdict.zh: 轻便廉价的单发反 ARC 榴弹枪，适合当副武器，不适合当主力。

use.en: It fires one grenade per reload, so every miss hurts. Use it from cover at close to medium range, since the grenade drops heavily at distance. Players use it against Wasps, Hornets, Shredders, Bombardiers and Bastions, but find it awkward against small ARC and swarms. Like the Hullcracker, it does nothing special to raiders.
use.zh: 每次装填只有一发，打偏就亏。适合在掩体后中近距离使用，远距离弹道下坠严重。玩家用它对付黄蜂、大黄蜂、粉碎者、投弹手和堡垒，但打小型 ARC 和群怪很别扭。与“裂甲者”一样，对人没有特殊效果。

obtain.en: It can drop as loot, unlike the Hullcracker. Reported blueprint sources are Hurricane caches, Raider Caches, Security Breach cabinets, locked key rooms and the weekly Nomadic Envoy stock. Tian Wen sells it for a steep price, and Boarding the Frigate rewards a Rascal I.
obtain.zh: 可以当战利品掉落，这点比“裂甲者”方便。蓝图常见来源有飓风补给箱、奇袭者箱、安防突破柜、钥匙房和每周“游牧使团”库存。天玟标价很高，任务“登上护卫者”奖励一把“无赖” I。

amplified.en: Sprint Shooting lets you fire while running, and High Velocity flattens the arc so the single shot lands more often. Incendiary Rounds add burn damage. Repair costs climb fast: up to 41 Amplified Fragments for the triple-perk version.
amplified.zh: “冲刺射击”可以边跑边开火，“高速弹丸”让弹道更平，单发更容易命中。“燃烧弹”增加灼烧伤害。修理费涨得快，三项叠加最高要 41 个增强碎片。

tips.en: Upgrades to IV are cheap, and IV cuts reload time by 20 percent, which matters most for a one-shot gun.
tips.zh: 升到 IV 花费不高，装填时间缩短 20%，对单发枪最关键。

tips.en: Rascal repair is much cheaper than a Hullcracker; keep the Hullcracker for bosses and use this for routine armored ARC.
tips.zh: “无赖”修理远比“裂甲者”便宜；首领留给“裂甲者”，日常装甲 ARC 用它。

tips.en: Check the Nomadic Envoy after each weekly reset; the Rascal is not guaranteed in stock.
tips.zh: 每周重置后去看看“游牧使团”，不保证有“无赖”。
